name: Anbernic RG40XX V
identify: helperFunctions.sh: cpuinfo CPU part "*0xd03*" (H700) -> reads BASEOS_TARGET from /etc/baseos-release; case "rg40xxv" -> PLATFORM=AnbernicXX640480OneStick

pad.from: derived: same ANBERNIC-keys/event1 pad as the other XX buckets (matrix; no own discovery capture for this bucket)
pad.note: A/B/X/Y, L1/R1, digital L2/R2, SELECT/START, MENU (plus its KEY_GOTO tap pulse), D-pad hat, stick axes and FF rumble, all on one event1 node (also enumerates as js0). Its EV_KEY bitmask also advertises KEY_ESC/KEY_VOLUMEDOWN/KEY_VOLUMEUP, but those three never actually fire on this node (controller-matrix C2 / RG28XX diagnostic capture).

vol.note: vendor's own typo for the node name, kept verbatim. KEY_VOLUMEUP 115 / KEY_VOLUMEDOWN 114 measured arriving here (not on event1) on RG34XX SP and RG40XX V by the NextUI port, and identified as the volume node in the RG28XX diagnostic capture (controller-matrix event2 entry; matrix: measured on this model (controller-matrix input_nodes.event2 provenance) for this bucket's own node).

power.from: derived: same axp2202-pek/event0 PMIC node as the other XX buckets (matrix; no own discovery capture for this bucket)

VOL_UP.cfg_differs: the code (115) matches the cfg's B_VOLUP, but the cfg's only input path is EVENT_PATH_READ_INPUTS_SPRUCE (event1/ANBERNIC-keys); that node advertises KEY_VOLUMEUP but never emits it. The press is measured arriving on event2 (dierct-keys-polled) instead (controller-matrix C2).

VOL_DOWN.cfg_differs: same as VOL_UP: the code (114) matches the cfg's B_VOLDOWN, but cfg implies event1, while measured delivery is event2 (controller-matrix C2).

absent.R3: no analog stick on this bucket's hardware; cfg still exports B_R3="1 316" (shared AnbernicXXCommon.cfg), but the nostick SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_MAP (_XX_GC_NOSTICK) binds no button there (derived from AnbernicXXCommon.cfg + controller-matrix idx table). RG40XX V-specific: the 1-stick gamecontroller map's unused R3 slot (sdl2 b15 / linuxraw 12) is where the MENU tap's synthetic KEY_GOTO (354) pulse lands instead, ~190 ms after release (controller-matrix C8, derived, no lab unit) -- a tester may see a spurious transient there; it is not a real R3.
absent.RIGHT_STICK: 1 stick on this bucket (left only; XX_PAD_LAYOUT="1stick" -> DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=1)
absent.LID: no lid on any model in this bucket
absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME="DOESNT_EXIST"; MENU is spruce's home key on this line (matrix)
absent.FN_SWITCH: no latching Fn switch on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)

notes: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME is computed at runtime; rg40xxv has its own arm: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic RG40XX V".

VOL_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/POWER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/CONTROLLER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH are exported in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg (event0/event2/event1) but nothing in the h700 tree reads them -- dead variables, not evidence for any control's source (grep of spruce/scripts at spruce_ref 0dccf5276b).

No discovery capture exists for this bucket in the lab captures; the pad/power node facts here are derived by parity with the rest of the XX line (matrix), except VOL-on-event2, which controller-matrix states was itself measured on this exact model (RG40XX V) by the NextUI port.
models are spruce's own SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME values (AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); Button Reader matches the unit's name against them
